notes: Build84 clean runtime starts from stable Build82. Shipped surface is allowlisted to the canonical launcher, event-driven runtime client, clean account controller, UX polish, isolated integration resource manager, minimal runtime bus and a small integration-selection service-worker wrapper. License activation, protocol-based Trust, GitHub, Supabase, resource allowlists and on-demand project state are reattached without the legacy DOM stack. GitHub repository access remains authoritative in the GitHub App installation; the Decrypter stores only which already-authorized repositories are enabled. Supabase OAuth remains authoritative for visible projects; the Decrypter stores only which OAuth-visible projects are enabled. No external repository/project is deleted when removed from the Decrypter. No legacy ui/content stack, mount guardian, global MutationObserver, continuous polling, heavy provider engine, OTA metadata or release publication is shipped.
